name: OpenVibe.Video
description: OpenVibe.Video is the watch site for the OpenVibe network: stream recordings and clips from OpenVibe.Live, each with a player, AI chapters and WebVTT captions, its clips and its OpenVibe.Community thread, and a page per channel. The files stay on OpenVibe.Media. Uploads, playlists and publishing to other platforms come later.
